captureRequirements: No application rows, passwords, access tokens, service keys or credential values. Protect raw schema artifacts; publish only reviewed metadata and digests.
Record original bytes and source authenticity separately from canonical JSON/hash equality. Observation time does not establish migration deployment time.
Preserve overloaded function signatures, owners, SECURITY DEFINER/search_path, effective ACLs and inherited roles; RLS enablement alone is insufficient.
Preserve duplicate historical migration filenames as distinct identities; compare actual applied history/effects against reviewed dispositions without applying migrations.
Include actual indexes, trigger enablement, constraint validation/delete effects and platform/auth schema coverage; the narrower Business descriptor does not claim those full-schema dimensions.
Comparison mismatches require reviewed classification; never infer safe adoption, current production compatibility or qualified approval from a local model.
